description:
**Annual land tax on land you own in a state or territory**, with the
tax-free threshold, each rate band and any foreign owner surcharge shown.

**Who pays it:** owners of land that isn't their home — investors with rental
properties, holiday homes, vacant land, companies and trusts. It is charged
every year on the combined land value of everything the owner holds in the
state, so two $800,000 blocks cost more than twice one.

**What it covers:** the general scale and threshold, the company / trust
rates or loss of the threshold where a state has them, any premium band, and
the foreign / absentee owner surcharge. The Northern Territory has no land
tax; the ACT charges it on rented-out homes. The land tax year in force on
`assessment_date` is used, named in `rates`.

**Caveats:** an estimate, not an assessment. Pass the land value (council or
state valuation), not the market price of the property — they differ a lot.
Primary production, charities, special trusts and part-year ownership have
rules not modelled here; see `caveats`. The home exemption is a flag, not a
calculation of mixed-use land.

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

assessment_date.description: Any date in the land tax year you want (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today in Sydney.

foreign.description: A foreign or absentee owner — adds the state's surcharge.

land_value.description: Total taxable land value you hold in the state, in dollars — the unimproved / site value of every parcel added together, not the property prices. Leave your own home out (it is exempt).

owner_type.description: One of: individual, company, trust. Companies and trusts pay higher rates or lose the threshold in some states.

principal_residence.description: The land is the owner's home. Always exempt; returns 0 with the reason.

state.description: State or territory: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT.
